page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.large is a general-purpose virtual instance belonging to the enhanced g7se family, powered by the KVM hypervisor. The instance is built on the x86_64 architecture and utilizes an Intel Xeon 8369B processor clocked at 2.9 GHz. It is provisioned with 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to a single physical core across two threads, backed by 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache. Memory allocation totals 8.0 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware instruction set support includes AVX, AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, as well as cryptographic extensions such as AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

The hardware configuration does not include local disk storage, necessitating the attachment of network-based block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. The system contains no discrete graphics hardware or machine learning accelerators.

Benchmark evaluations reveal distinct single-threaded versus multi-threaded execution characteristics. Single-core performance is steady, with Geekbench single-core reaching 1,556.0 and single-threaded gzip compression achieving 27.62 GB/sec, placing it within average tier percentiles. Conversely, parallel metrics such as PassMark CPU (2,988.3) and multi-core Geekbench (1,815.0) reflect the constraints of relying on two threads on one physical core. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth measured at 15.1 GB/sec and write bandwidth at 13.63 GB/sec, demonstrating entry-level throughput. Redis SET throughput attained 1.97 million operations per second, while static web serving throughput reached 3.5 GB/sec.

From an efficiency and workload perspective, ecs.g7se.large delivers reliable dedicated CPU capacity for smaller footprints without the unpredictability of burstable CPU credits. Because multithreaded capacity and memory bandwidth are limited by the single-core topology, it is not structured for heavy compilation, parallel scientific simulations, or large relational databases. It serves as an appropriate deployment target for lightweight microservices, internal staging environments, background queue workers, and low-concurrency web servers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.large is a general-purpose compute instance based on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz, it supplies 2 dedicated vCPUs over 1 physical core along with 8.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation. The processor integrates AVX-512 and cryptographic accelerators, while the system operates with a 1 Gbps baseline network and no bundled local storage. Synthetic benchmarks demonstrate average single-core capability in tests like Stress-NG and Geekbench, contrasted with modest multi-threaded throughput and memory bandwidth constrained by the dual-thread boundary. With zero discrete GPUs, this instance provides cost-effective dedicated resource isolation for entry-tier enterprise tasks, microservices, dev-test environments, and low-traffic web applications.
